name: Workspace monitoring log support for Eventstream
description: Eventstream now writes operational logs to Fabric workspace monitoring, giving users visibility into stream health and behavior. This helps users detect issues, audit activity, and tune pipelines using familiar Fabric monitoring tools.With this capability, you can:- View Eventstream logs alongside other Eventstream metrics.- Investigate failures and delays with detailed operational records.- Track activity over time to support auditing and troubleshooting.

result.nameEs: Registros de Workspace Monitoring para Eventstream
